title: Approval for High-Risk Actions
content: Any corrective action involving transaction reprocessing, hold release, or status change must require human approval when confidence is low or the business impact is medium or high.

title: Retry Policy for Transient Failures
content: Timeout-related failures may be retried when evidence suggests a transient downstream condition and retry count is within safe threshold.

title: Escalation Policy
content: Repeated failures after corrective retry or conflicting evidence should trigger escalation instead of repeated automated recommendation.

title: Receiving Approval for High-Impact Reprocessing
content: receiving corrective actions that reprocess live transactions, reopen status, or alter operational history require human approval when business impact is medium or higher.

title: Receiving Retry Threshold for Transient Failures
content: Retry receiving failures only when evidence indicates a transient condition and retry count remains within the approved safe threshold.

title: Receiving Escalation After Repeated Failure
content: If the same receiving issue persists after the recommended corrective action or two retries, escalate instead of looping automation.

title: Receiving Duplicate Event Protection
content: Do not auto-reprocess duplicate-sensitive receiving events when the evidence indicates replay, duplicate submission, or idempotency conflict.

title: Receiving Audit Trail for Manual Correction
content: Any manual data correction applied to a receiving transaction must capture who changed it, what changed, and why the correction was required.

title: Receiving Closed Period and Backdate Restriction
content: Do not recommend backdated or closed-period receiving posting changes unless a controller or designated approver explicitly authorizes the action.

title: Receiving Tolerance Override Review
content: Quantity, tolerance, or policy overrides in receiving require supervisor review before the transaction is reprocessed.

title: Receiving Quality and Compliance Hold Gate
content: When receiving evidence points to quality hold, quarantine, export hold, or supplier compliance hold, the system must recommend review before release.

title: Receiving Conflicting Evidence Escalation
content: If evidence for a receiving issue conflicts across sources, escalate the recommendation rather than choosing an automated corrective action.

title: Receiving Privileged Access Requirement
content: Configuration, role, or master-data changes used to resolve receiving failures must be performed only by users with approved privileged access.

title: Receiving Queue Backlog Backoff
content: When queue depth or service backlog affects receiving processing, apply delayed retry and avoid immediate repeated execution.

title: Receiving Credential and Certificate Ownership
content: Authentication, token, or certificate failures affecting receiving should route to the integration or platform owner rather than business users.

title: Receiving Reprint and Repeat Action Justification
content: Repeated receiving actions such as reprints, reissues, or repeated submissions require a reason code before execution.

title: Receiving Financial Impact Review
content: If the recommended receiving fix can change inventory valuation, financial recognition, freight billing, or credit outcome, require human review.

title: Receiving Safe Recommendation Boundary
content: Recommendations for receiving should prefer safe diagnosis and next-step guidance over direct automation when confidence is low or irreversible impact is possible.
